notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.43 wheel; GPT-6.1 Sol (high reasoning) through GitHub Copilot, with fast-agent's stream-idle timeout raised from the default 150 s to 300 s (streaming_timeout=300). Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. Three infrastructure failures (a sandbox error, two connection errors) were rerun as replacements; the originals are kept as evidence.

An earlier complete cohort with the default 150 s stream-idle timeout (tb21-sol61-high-copilot-002) is not shown: at high effort 8 of its trials failed deterministically on that timeout. This run repeats the configuration with only the timeout changed.

Safety refusals: 13 trials ended with AgentSafetyRefusalError and score 0, except one break-filter-js-from-html trial whose verifier still passed: it counts as a pass here; bench-run's stricter rule counts it 0 (380/445).

Cost is Harbor's recorded cost at the cohort's configured OpenAI list rates (card-packs pricing catalog, rules gpt-6.1-sol-standard-short / -long: $2 / $0.10 / $10 per million input / cached / output tokens; $4 / $0.20 / $15 above 272k context). The run used GitHub Copilot, so this is a list-price equivalent, not what Copilot billed. Some trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
